purpose: Wound, frozen, exhaustion, fear, humiliation beats. Realism mode in Sketch to Life / Canvas to Life; lifelike 3D in Canvas to 3D.
camera_default: [Static shot] or a very slow [Push in]
emotion_rule: A pain line never gets a smile. 'Warm' is a lighting word, never a face word. Wet glistening eyes only on the one or two deepest moments (realism note D20).
beats_pattern: still weight -> the small break (hands, breath, shoulders) -> the held aftermath
